name: Polaris Dawn
about: Polaris Dawn (2024-161A), a crewed vehicle (Dragon 2), launched 2024 Sep 10. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (L).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (2024 Sep 10), held fixed
